text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, not long after the successful series with Daiwa Scarlet, I find myself working in my office as usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being the trainer of the number one Umamusume means making time for the press in my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My desk creaks under the weight of several stacks of paper. The deadlines are still a ways away, but I might pull an all-nighter tonight to get it all out of the way…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer! It's time! Where are you?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Don't act like you don't know! Remember that thing I gave you that one time in the shopping district?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That one time in the shopping district? She can only mean…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You keep it for now. I don't think I can trust myself with it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But you'd better not use it on yourself! It's my prize, got that?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The hot spring coupon! It expires this month, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Come on, what are you waiting for?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We need to find it! Good grief, look at this desk! It's a complete mess!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll help you out, so come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To the hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet pesters me into planning an impromptu hot spring trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Mmm… Ahhh… The hot water felt so good.
choice_data_list: You look like you've been enjoying yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, maybe a bit!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What about you? Are you feeling relaxed? Like you can finally take it easy for once?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd like to say yes, but she basically dragged me here. I'm more confused than anything.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, fine. I'm sorry I forced you into this out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But you're also to blame, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is finally over, so this should have been the perfect time…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But you're always so busy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Obviously, you have a lot more on your plate than most people, being in charge of the number one Umamusume and all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But seeing you working yourself ragged makes me kind of mad.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I start to wonder why you're the only one exhausting themselves, you know? Aren't we supposed to face our obstacles together?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Do you really feel like you can't come to me for support?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's not? Great. Then give me a chance to show you I care.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Let me carry your burdens sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's then that I remember what she said when she won the hot spring coupon.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't think so. I mean, we're in the middle of a very important series. Neither of us have time to take a break just yet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to make the most of this chance to relax… and I want you to make the most of it too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …What? You're looking at me weird.
choice_data_list: All right. I'm in your care.
All right. I'm in your care.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Glad you finally get it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now, let's enjoy ourselves! We came here to get away from work, remember?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I won't let you leave until you've taken a proper break! Hehe. You'd better relax as hard as you can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swept up in Daiwa Scarlet's momentum, I enjoy a long overdue vacation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Days later and feeling completely refreshed, I finish off the rest of my workload… with Scarlet's help, of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Daiwa Scarlet and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
